summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Saudi Equity Investment Dashboard. Backend APIs fully functional with 12/12 tests passing. Frontend loads correctly but has critical integration issue preventing user registration/login due to external API URL being unavailable.

resolved_bugs.issue: Authorization header dependency injection not working correctly
resolved_bugs.fix_applied: Updated FastAPI dependency injection to use Header() for Authorization token

critical_bugs.issue: Frontend making API calls to external preview URL (https://4fe2b8c0-bb2a-4d21-8ddc-cb97113d6dd6.preview.emergentagent.com) which returns 404 - External preview service is inactive
critical_bugs.impact: Prevents all user authentication (registration/login) and dashboard functionality

integration_issues.issue: Frontend-Backend integration broken due to external URL dependency
integration_issues.root_cause: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to inactive external preview URL instead of working backend

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Frontend environment variable REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is pointing to inactive external preview URL. The backend is fully functional on localhost:8001, but frontend cannot access it. External preview service shows 'Preview Unavailable - Agent is resting after inactivity'. Need to either: 1) Restart the external preview service, or 2) Reconfigure frontend to use working backend URL for proper testing.
